completion_criteria: Origin workflow parses. Held jobs stay if false. A failed test fails the job.
Push on V13 runs only Stage A. Main is unchanged. An artifact records the SHA.
Each of the 18 decisions is approved or explicitly rejected. No rule is invented.
Both write flags are 1. Run id and testing identity exist. URL is local and matches the disposable name pattern.
A named migration is authorized only after the decision that needs it.
Existing behavior is asserted on stored rows. Rollback is shown. A mock is not a pass.
Browser flag is 1 and the same disposable URL passes the guard.
A signed-in non-administrator receives HTTP 403 on the test-database route. A login redirect is not that denial.
Activation writes the account link. Wrong patient, expiry, and replay are denied on stored state.
An approved capacity rule rejects a second competing session. In-memory overlap is not the evidence.
Approved merge keeps lineage. Automatic merge is not added.
Amendment, escalation, substitution, and allergy follow the approved rule only.
Hold and disposal follow the approved period. No deletion runs before that.
An authorized restore drill records the result. A plan is not evidence.
Writes stay disabled until an approved recovery rule exists. The current route remains HTTP 503.
Targets come from an approved number. No threshold is invented.
A versioned clinical API and outbox exist only after that decision.
Remains off until emergency-access policy is approved.
Signing stays disabled. Optional tests do not activate it.
ACX-001 through ACX-008 stay outside this release until separately approved.
The blocked acceptance case is evidenced by the live denial, not by a route-source assertion.
